mode.label: Mode
mode.manualHint: You pick the algorithm and any reductions. The combination is checked before it runs.
mode.automaticHint: RACoN picks a certified method and records why.
mode.noneHint: Runs the chosen algorithm as is, with no reduction.
classic: Classic graph algorithm; no Petri-net-specific paper.
howItWorks: How it works, limits and references
doNotConclude: Do not conclude from this result
monotonicityBlocked: the required monotonicity does not hold for nets with inhibitors/immediate transitions.
reductionBlocked: is not valid for nets with inhibitors/immediate transitions.
title: Analysis algorithm
extendedWarning: Net with inhibitor arcs/immediate transitions: only exact exploration (BFS/DFS) is valid; Karp–Miller, MinCov and reductions rely on monotonicity and are blocked.
noReductions: No reduction applies to this objective.
doNotConcludeResult: Do NOT conclude from the result
reachabilityBlocked: Unavailable: the net is unbounded, so its reachability set is infinite.
reco.bounded: Bounded net: the exact reachability graph is finite.
reco.unknown: Boundedness unknown: coverability decides it, so it is preselected.
